definitions.gloss: to be mixed, to be blended
definitions.explanation: To become combined with something else.

examples.japanese: {砂糖|さとう}が{水|みず}に{混|ま}ざった。
examples.english: The sugar mixed into the water.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}と{青|あお}が{混|ま}ざって{紫|むらさき}になった。
examples.english: Red and blue mixed to make purple.

notes:
{混|ま}ざる is a godan verb meaning to be mixed or blended.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {混|ま}ぜる (transitive - to mix)

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- AがBに{混|ま}ざる: A mixes into B
- AとBが{混|ま}ざる: A and B mix together

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {色|いろ}が{混|ま}ざる: colors blend
- {砂糖|さとう}が{水|みず}に{混|ま}ざる: sugar dissolves into water
- {人|ひと}に{混|ま}ざる: to mingle with people

ALTERNATE KANJI:
- {混|ま}ざる: to be mixed (substances)
- {交|ま}ざる: to mingle (people, used interchangeably)

SIMILAR VERBS:
- {混|ま}じる: to be mixed (slightly more literary)
- {混|こ}む: to be crowded (different reading)
